entries.title: Revelation of John 3:1
segments: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: These things saith he that has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars: I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:2
segments: Be watchful, and strengthen the things that remain, which are about to die, for I have not found thy works complete before my God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:3
segments: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and keep [it] and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come [upon thee] as a thief, and thou shalt not know at what hour I shall come upon thee.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:4
segments: But thou hast a few names in Sardis which have not defiled their garments, and they shall walk with me in white, because they are worthy.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:5
segments: He that overcomes, *he* shall be clothed in white garments, and I will not blot his name out of the book of life, and will confess his name before my Father and before his angels.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:6
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:7
segments: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: These things saith the holy, the true; he that has the key of David, he who opens and no one shall shut, and shuts and no one shall open:

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:8
segments: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an opened door, which no one can shut, because thou hast a little power, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:9
segments: Behold, I make them of the synagogue of Satan who say that they are Jews, and are not, but lie; behold, I will cause that they shall come and shall do homage before thy feet, and shall know that *I* have loved thee.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:10
segments: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, *I* also will keep thee out of the hour of trial, which is about to come upon the whole habitable world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:11
segments: I come quickly: hold fast what thou hast, that no one take thy crown.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:12
segments: He that overcomes, him will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more at all out; and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven, from my God, and my new name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:13
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:14
segments: ¶And to the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:15
segments: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot; I would thou wert cold or hot.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:16
segments: Thus because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I am about to spue thee out of my mouth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:17
segments: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and am grown rich, and have need of nothing, and knowest not that *thou* art the wretched and the miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked;

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:18
segments: I counsel thee to buy of me gold purified by fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white garments, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness may not be made manifest; and eye-salve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:19
segments: I rebuke and discipline as many as I love; be zealous therefore and repent.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:20
segments: Behold, I stand at the door and am knocking; if any one hear my voice and open the door, I will come in unto him and sup with him, and he with me.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:21
segments: He that overcomes, to him will I give to sit with me in my throne; as *I* also have overcome, and have sat down with my Father in his throne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:22
segments: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
